messages.author: 28f7cf43544f2467
messages.subject: Fill geom_histogram based on factor
parts:
Appologies in advance for not supplying an example data set.

I'm producing a histogram of a data set with an overlayed density
line. I 'd like to fill the bars of the histogram depending on a
variable in my data.frame called "colour_bin" ("high" or "low").

Passing the following in geom_histogram results in the graph linked
below. THis is all of the data combined.

geom_histogram(colour="darkgreen",fill="white",aes(y=..density..))

http://dl.dropbox.com/u/3734701/Image1.jpg

I'd like to colour bars in the histogram differently based on the
values of a column of factors in my data.frame. When I pass the
foloowing to geom_histogram...I get the foloowing image.

geom_histogram(colour="black",aes(y=..density..,fill=colour_bin))

http://dl.dropbox.com/u/3734701/Image2.jpg

It seems like the distribution is being altered by this act. Do i need
to change what i am passing to geom_density as well? Any advice is
appreciated.

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Fill geom_histogram based on factor
parts:
> I'd like to colour bars in the histogram differently based on the
> values of a column of factors in my data.frame. When I pass the
> foloowing to geom_histogram...I get the foloowing image.
>
> geom_histogram(colour="black",aes(y=..density..,fill=colour_bin))

When you use y = ..density.. each histogram is individually scaled to
have area 1.

Hadley
